arguments.query: SELECT o.order_ts,o.status,i.quantity,i.unit_price_cents,p.list_price_twd FROM orders o JOIN order_items i USING(order_id) JOIN products p USING(product_id) LIMIT 8
SELECT r.refund_ts, r.refund_amount_twd, r.item_id, r.order_id FROM refunds r LIMIT 5

WITH v AS (SELECT order_id FROM orders WHERE status IN (1,2,3) AND datetime(order_ts,"+8 hours")>="2025-11-01" AND datetime(order_ts,"+8 hours")<"2025-12-01") SELECT (SELECT SUM(quantity*unit_price_cents)/100.0 FROM order_items WHERE order_id IN (SELECT order_id FROM v)) AS gross, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(refund_amount_twd),0) FROM refunds WHERE order_id IN (SELECT order_id FROM v)) AS ref, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM v) AS n
